title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.

  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.

title: Analista De Crédito Sênior (Motor De Crédito)
description:
A área de Comercial de Crédito e Serviço é responsável pelo fomento comercial, desenvolvimento de produtos, ações comerciais e capacitação das cooperativas centrais e singulares do Sicoob para os produtos de crédito, sejam eles geridos pelas cooperativas ou CCS.

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas e normas de crédito, assegurando aderência às regras de negócio, apetite de risco e exigências regulatórias;
  • Gerenciar as políticas de crédito no motor de decisão, incluindo criação, parametrização, revisão, implantação e versionamento de regras e estratégias;
  • Analisar dados para monitoramento da decisão massiva de crédito, avaliando performance, consistência e eficiência dos fluxos automatizados;

  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de crédito (taxa de aprovação, motivos de recusa, inadimplência, rentabilidade, entre outros), identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização;
  • Estruturar, manter e evoluir modelos de crédito, scorecards e variáveis preditivas, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e de machine learning;
  • Propor e implementar evoluções no motor de crédito, incluindo ajustes de regras, estratégias, fluxos de decisão e integrações com fontes de dados internas e externas;
  • Realizar análises exploratórias de dados (EDA), monitoramento de performance de carteiras e indicadores de risco (PD, LGD, EAD, approval rate, inadimplência etc.);
  • Garantir o monitoramento contínuo e a recalibração de modelos e políticas de crédito, com base em desempenho e mudanças de cenário;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com os times de Dados, Produto, Tecnologia, Compliance e Jurídico, assegurando eficiência operacional e conformidade regulatória;
  • Apoiar decisõesestratégicas por meio de estudos analíticos, de impacto e simulações de cenários;
  • Documentar metodologias, modelos, políticas e decisões, garantindo auditabilidade, rastreabilidade e boas práticas de governança.


Requisitos

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de Administração, Matemática, Economia, Informática ou Engenharia;
  • MBA em Risco deCrédito/Banking;
    Data Science Aplicado aFinanças, áreas correlatas

  • Document data processes and support team knowledge sharing


Need to Haves

  • Experience with SQL (querying, joins, aggregations)
  • Strong English skills – able to communicate clearly in writing and conversation

Nice to Haves

We value curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn. If you're starting your journey in data engineering and want to grow with a supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Pessoa Engenheira De Dados Java Senior
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

● Desenvolver aplicações e serviços backend em Java (usando Spring Boot) focados no processamento e integração de dados, incluindo a construção de APIs RESTful ou microserviços que permitam o consumo e fornecimento de dados via base dimensional.

● Implementar pipelines de dados e fluxos de processamento em Java, integrando com sistemas de mensageria (ex: Apache Kafka) e outros mecanismos de streaming quando necessário, para capturar dados transacionais em tempo real e persistí-los de forma segura.

● Projetar e otimizar esquemas de banco de dados PostgreSQL para armazenar dados = provenientes de sistemas legados ou da camada de ingestão, garantindo normalização adequada ou modelagem relacional conforme necessário, além de criar índices e otimizar consultas para alto desempenho.

● Colaborar com o time de arquitetura e outros engenheiros de dados para assegurar que as soluções desenvolvidas em Java/PostgreSQL estejam alinhadas com a arquitetura dimensional e não gerem redundâncias ou inconsistências com as demais fontes de dados.

● Implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e monitoramento nos serviços desenvolvidos, assegurando que falhas sejam rapidamente identificadas (logs, métricas, telemetria) e colaborando com a equipe de SRE para implantar monitoramento e alertas adequados.

● Participar da integração de dados entre o PostgreSQL e outras camadas da plataforma (por exemplo, exportando dados para Data Lake ou fornecendo dados atualizados para aplicações de relatório), escrevendo scripts ou procedimentos armazenados quando necessário.

● Dar suporte e manutenção evolutiva aos componentes desenvolvidos, tanto durante a fase de construção quanto na sustentação posterior, incluindo documentação clara do código e das integrações realizadas.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Experiência em construção de APIs REST e microserviços, com práticas de versionamento, segurança (autenticação/autorização) e documentação (OpenAPI/Swagger).

● Familiaridade com sistemas de mensageria e event streaming (Kafka ou similares) e integração de aplicações Java com esses sistemas (producers/consumers, processamento de eventos).

● Conhecimento de ferramentas de build e entrega contínua para Java (Maven/Gradle, Jenkins/GitLab CI) e experiência básica em containerização (Docker) para deploy dos serviços.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Pessoa Engenheira De Dados Senior (Databricks E Mongodb)
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO

● Implementar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados no Databricks, desenvolvendo código otimizado em Apache Spark (PySpark/Scala) para processar grandes volumes de dados provenientes de sistemas transacionais e logs.

● Projetar e manter estruturas de dados no MongoDB para armazenar e consultar dados semi-estruturados ou não relacionais, definindo modelos de documentos adequados e índices para garantir desempenho nas consultas.

● Integrar o MongoDB ao ecossistema da plataforma de dados, implementando pipelines que migrem ou sincronizem dados entre o MongoDB e outros repositórios (por exemplo, Data Lake ou PostgreSQL), conforme necessário para o projeto.

● Otimizar a performance de jobs e consultas, ajustando configurações de cluster Databricks/Spark (particionamento, paralelismo) e realizando otimizações no MongoDB (por meio de gestão de índices, sharding ou replicação, se aplicável).

● Colaborar com o Tech Lead e Arquiteto de Dados para garantir que as soluções implementadas em Databricks e MongoDB estejam alinhadas à arquitetura global e atendam aos padrões de qualidade e segurança.

● Identificar gargalos ou problemas de dados (ex: inconformidades, atrasos no pipeline, falhas de integração) e propor soluções eficazes, implementando melhorias de forma proativa.

● Documentar os processos desenvolvidos (notebooks, scripts, configurações do cluster, estruturas do MongoDB) para facilitar a manutenção futura e a transição para a fase de sustentação após o projeto.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Atuação em projetos de Big Data e processamento distribuído.

● Domínio da plataforma Databricks e do ecossistema Apache Spark (incluindo escrita

de jobs em PySpark e/ou Scala), com experiência em otimização de jobs, gerenciamento de clusters e uso de Delta Lake.

● Experiência avançada com MongoDB, incluindo design de coleções, consultas complexas (Aggregation Framework), índices e boas práticas de desempenho e replicação.

● Familiaridade com linguagens de programação e scripts para manipulação de dados (Python, Scala e SQL), assim como uso de APIs e conectores para integração entre Spark, MongoDB e outros sistemas.

● Conhecimentos de sistemas de mensageria/streaming de dados (ex: Kafka) para trabalhar com integrações em tempo real, caso parte dos dados seja recebida via streams.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Coordenador(A) De Qualidade Do Atendimento
description:
Sobre a gente


A LG lugar de gente é referência em tecnologia para gestão de pessoas. Ajudamos empresas de todo o Brasil a evoluírem seus modelos de gestão e o desenvolvimento dos seus times, sempre com pessoas no centro das decisões.

  • Criar e sustentar o processo de monitoria de qualidade multicanal (voz, chat, e-mail, tickets), incluindo critérios, scorecards, amostragem, calibração e contestações.
  • Analisar indicadores como NPS, CSAT, FCR, TMA, taxa de retrabalho e reincidência, traduzindo dados em insights acionáveis.
  • Conduzir análises profundas de causa raiz dos problemas de atendimento, conectando comportamento, processo, produto e comunicação.

Sobre a Empresa


A Alimak Group é um fornecedor global de soluções sustentáveis de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura para os setores comercial, industrial e da construção. Com presença em mais de 120 países, o Grupo desenvolve, fabrica, comercializa e presta serviços de soluções de acesso vertical e trabalho em altura, com foco em agregar valor ao cliente por meio de maior segurança, maior produtividade e melhoria da eficiência de custos.


O Grupo possui uma ampla base instalada de elevadores, elevadores de serviço, guindastes e plataformas temporários e permanentes, bem como unidades de manutenção predial em todo o mundo. O portfólio de soluções também compreende equipamentos de proteção contra quedas, medição e controle de carga, içamento e manuseio, além de um modelo global de pós-venda, com receita recorrente de peças de reposição e serviços, como inspeção, certificação, manutenção, reformas, substituições e treinamento.


Fundado na Suécia em 1948, o Grupo tem a sede em Estocolmo, 26 fábricas e unidades de montagem em 15 países e aproximadamente 3.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Na Alimak Group, entendemos que nossos colaboradores são a chave para o nosso sucesso. title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisõesfiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

title: Legal & Compliance Analyst
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a Legal & Compliance professional to support our growing business in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. This role sits at the intersection of legal advisory, contract management, and regulatory compliance , ensuring that our operations, partnerships, and transactions align with applicable laws, internal policies, and regulatory expectations.

You will work closely with commercial, product, and operational teams, contributing both strategically and hands-on to legal and compliance matters, while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.


What You’ll Do


Legal Responsibilities

  • Review, draft, and analyze technology, SaaS, and partnership agreements, identifying legal and regulatory risks, ensuring alignment with internal policies;
  • Support the commercial team during contract negotiations by providing practical legal advice and balancing business needs with compliance requirements;
  • Conduct legal research and analysis on applicable laws, regulations, and regulatory frameworks relevant to the business.


Compliance Responsibilities

  • Perform transaction monitoring activities, including alert analysis, identification of unusual or suspicious transactions, and AML/CTF risk assessments;
  • Prepare compliance reports and support regulatory filings when required;
  • Conduct ClientDue Diligence (CDD), EDD, including KYC, KYE, and KYS reviews;
  • Support onboarding decisions using a risk-based assessment framework;
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal compliance policies.


What We’re Looking For

  • Ability to manage multiple matters simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment;
  • Background in legal contract analysis and negotiation , particularly in technology or SaaS contexts;
  • Knowledge or experience in compliance activities , including AML/CTF, transaction monitoring, and due diligence processes;
  • Strong analytical and research skills related to legal and regulatory matters;
  • High attentionto detail, sound judgment, and strong sense of responsibility;
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.


We Appreciate

  • Experience in the virtual assets, blockchain, cryptoassets, or fintech space;
  • Exposure to regulated environments and interaction with regulators or regulatory frameworks;
  • Understanding of digital asset business models, regulatory risks, and compliance obligations;
  • Experience working in fast-growing or scale-up environments.

title: Fullstack Engineer (Python)
description:
About the Opportunity:

We are hiring Fullstack Engineer (Python). You will play a key role in building and maintaining integrations within Veriff’s ecosystem, contributing to high-quality, secure, and reliable data processing pipelines. This role involves working with multiple external providers, complex REST APIs, and integrating with both monolithic and microservices architectures.


Responsibilities:

  • Build complete onboarding integrations from external data provider APIs into Veriff’s internal workflows.
  • Implement data normalization and transformation logic.
  • Develop connector implementations following Veriff’s Connector Hub standards.
  • Ensure production-grade quality, security, and reliability.
  • Implement REST API integrations, authentication (OAuth, API keys, custom), data mapping, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  • Work on performance optimizations and rate limiting.
  • Collaborate with the internal Connector Hub team, providing feedback and suggesting improvements.
  • Work within existing monolithic and microservices architecture and integrate with RabbitMQ.


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience with Python.
  • Strong command of Python (async, error handling, data structures).
  • Significant hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, working with 8+ different providers .
  • Expertise in data parsing, mapping, and transformation (JSON/XML parsing and manipulation).
  • Experience with RabbitMQ or other message-queue systems.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including production API issues.
  • Fast learner with the ability to understand and adapt to new vendor APIs.
  • Ability to write clear, concise technical documentation.


Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with multi-provider integrations .
  • Domain knowledge in identity verification, KYC, or fintech .
  • Understanding of the Latin American or European markets .

title: Pessoa Engenheira De Infraestrutura Especialista
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

● Planejar, implantar e manter a infraestrutura necessária para o pipeline de dados, incluindo servidores, containers ou clusters (por exemplo, configuração de clusters Spark/Databricks, instâncias de banco de dados PostgreSQL, clusters MongoDB e brokers Kafka), seja em ambiente de nuvem ou on-premises, garantindo configurações adequadas de alta disponibilidade e redundância.

● Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automação de deploy das aplicações e componentes de dados (serviços Java, notebooks Databricks, configurações de bancos), promovendo entregas constantes e confiáveis sem interrupção do serviço.

● Implementar soluções de monitoramento, logging e alerta para todos os componentes da plataforma (uso de ferramentas como Prometheus/Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes), garantindo observabilidade completa do sistema (métricas de performance, falhas, latências, utilização de recursos) e resposta rápida a incidentes.

● Trabalhar junto aos engenheiros de dados e desenvolvedores para melhorar a confiabilidade das aplicações, revisando configurações, identificando pontos únicos de falha e implementando soluções de resiliência (como balanceamento de carga, retries automáticos, fallback).

● Gerenciar a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, aplicando atualizações de sistema, patches de segurança, configurações de firewall e acessos apropriados, em alinhamento com políticas corporativas e requisitos (por exemplo, LGPD).

● Otimizar a performance e custo da infraestrutura, monitorando uso de recursos e escalando ambientes conforme necessidade (vertical ou horizontalmente), bem como implementando rotinas de housekeeping (expurgo de logs, archiving de dados) para manter o ambiente saudável.

● Liderar a resposta a incidentes críticos relacionados à infraestrutura ou disponibilidade dos sistemas de dados, investigando raiz de problemas (post- mortem) e implementando ações preventivas para evitar recorrências.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Domínio de sistemas operacionais Linux e competências em automação de infraestrutura (shell scripting, Python) e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares).

● Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) para gerir serviços containerizados e escalar aplicações.

● Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) ou com ambientes virtualizados on-premises, compreendendo rede, armazenamento e computação, e habilidade para configurar serviços como bancos de dados gerenciados, balanceadores de carga, etc.

● Prática em configurar e manter ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, etc.) e interpretar métricas para troubleshooting.

● Familiaridade com conceitos de SRE, incluindo definição de SLOs/SLAs, error budget, e experiência em protocolos de resposta a incidentes.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.

  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.

  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist: AI Training Data (2-4 Months Contract)

Company: BespokeLabs (VC-backed;
founded by IIT & Ivy League alumni)

Location: Remote

Role Type: Contract (2-4 Months)

Time Commitment: 40 hrs/week (Full-time availability required)

Compensation: Hyper-competitive hourly rate (matching top-tier Senior Data Scientist bands) Experience: 6+ years


About BespokeLabs

BespokeLabs is a premier, VC-backed AI Research lab with an exceptionally talent-dense team of IIT and Ivy League alumni. We don’t just build tooling around AI—we build the massive-scale data systems and reasoning architectures that directly power next-generation models. Our research shapes the frontier of AI: we’ve published breakthroughs like GEPA, driven foundational datasets like OpenThoughts, and shipped state-of-the-art models including Bespoke-MiniCheck and Bespoke-MiniChart. More on our website bespokelabs.Ai :)

Role Overview

We are looking for a high-impact Senior Data Scientist for an intensive, 2-month sprint. You will leverage your deep expertise in production-grade machine learning and applied statistics to develop the algorithms and logic that curate and evaluate datasets for advanced AI model training.

This is not a traditional model-building or research role. We need a seasoned practitioner who has already owned the end-to-end DS lifecycle at scale. You will use your intuition for feature engineering, statistical validity, and large-scale data processing to programmatically generate, shape, and validate AI training data.


What You Will Do (The Contract)

  • Algorithm Design: Design and implement custom statistical models and programmatic logic (e.G., anomaly detection, active learning, similarity scoring) to evaluate data quality, complexity, and redundancy at scale.
  • Hands-on At-Scale Coding: Write scalable PySpark and Python (NumPy/Pandas) code to apply these algorithms across massive datasets, translating experimental logic into reliable, large-scale workflows.
  • Metric Formulation: Develop custom quantitative metrics and heuristic benchmarks to rigorously assess the fidelity and suitability of data subsets for specific AI training objectives.
  • Validation & Iteration: Run high-speed validation cycles, analyzing the output of data-curation algorithms to diagnose skew, bias, or noise, and iteratively refining the logic.
  • High-Level Curation: Apply Senior-level domain expertise in predictive modeling and feature engineering to ensure the final training inputs meet the strict standards required for state-of-the-art ML systems.


What You Bring to the Table (Your Past Experience)

To be successful in this contract, you must have a track record of:

  • The End-to-End DS Lifecycle: Framing problems, modeling, validation, production, and iteration.
  • Production Ownership: Building and deploying ML and statistical models on large-scale datasets.
  • Large-Scale Data Processing: Working with Apache Spark to develop scalable feature pipelines and offline training workflows.
  • Experimentation: Designing and analyzing rigorous experiments (A/B tests, causal inference).
  • Impact: Translating complex model outputs into clear product and business decisions.


Required Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

  • Experience: 6+ years as a Data Scientist or Applied Scientist.
  • Production Background: Proven ownership of models running in production environments.
  • Applied Statistics: Strong background in applied statistics and experimentation frameworks.

Core Technical Skills

  • Languages: Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch / TensorFlow) and Strong SQL.
  • Big Data: Apache Spark (PySpark or Spark SQL) for large-scale data processing.
  • Methodologies: Feature engineering, model evaluation, statistical modeling, and hypothesis testing.


Strong Signals (Highly Valued)

  • Scale: Models trained on TB-scale datasets.
  • Domain Specificity: Experience in high-complexity domains such as: Recommendations, Pricing, Fraud / risk, Search / ranking, or Growth & experimentation.
  • Collaboration: Experience deploying models alongside data engineering pipelines.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, and Brazilian office in Barueri, SP, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.


The Sales Engineer plays a key role in achieving sales targets for Greenlane’s biogas desulfurization and upgrading systems by combining strong technical expertise with commercial acumen. This role provides vital support to the sales team by developing sales proposals that meet the needs of our customers through a portfolio of configure-to-order products across a number of product lines. You will support the sales process by joining the Commercial Director in customer meetings and completing customer-focused activities necessary to advance opportunities through the sales pipeline. You will also influence the direction of Greenlane’s product roadmap by sharing internally voice-of-customer feedback and engaging with and supporting the global product management team.


Key Duties & Responsibilities:


  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of Greenlane’s full suite of biogas desulfurization and upgrading technologies and product lines, including product attributes, benefits over the competition, selling features, and configurable parameters, and and apply this knowledge to develop compelling sales proposals for existing and new prospective customers in Brazil and across Latin America.
  • Maintain and continuously update a database of technical and commercial information to ensure prompt, clear, and accurate responses to client inquiries and to capture voice-of-customer feedback.
  • Support Commercial Director in customer meetings and on sales calls to progress opportunities through the sales pipeline.
  • Evaluate and clearly communicate the advantages and trade-offs of various technical solutions to help clients identify the most suitable approach for their specific project requirements.
  • Differentiate and articulate the value proposition of Greenlane’s solutions compared to competing offerings within the industry.
  • Prepare detailed technical and commercial proposals that effectively translate complex engineering concepts into compelling client-focused solutions.
  • Ensure that all client interactions are conducted in a professional, organized, and timely manner that reinforces Greenlane’s reputation for integrity, quality, responsiveness, creativity, and thought-leadership.
  • Foster collaborative relationships with internal teams, EPC´s, suppliers, and customers to ensure alignment and to set up the project execution teams for success.
  • Proactively identify and recommend improvements to internal processes, workflows, and solution offerings.
  • Build and maintain strong networks within the biomethane industry to stay informed on emerging technologies, market trends, and potential business opportunities.
  • Accurately document and manage all sales activities within the company’s CRM system.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline) and a minimum of 5 years of experience in a Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales capacity within a technology-driven environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Technical expertise in air or gas compression, purification, treatment, or separation—ideally with exposure to natural gas or biomethane applications.
  • Professional working proficiency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.
  • Strong understanding of solution-based selling, including the ability to identify customer pain points and communicate how Greenlane’s technology uniquely meets their needs.
  • Familiarity with the biogas and biomethane markets in Brazil is a strong asset.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, proactive, and passionate about clean technology, with a proven record of delivering customer-focused solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and rapport across multiple organizational levels.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities with a track record of managing competing priorities under tight deadlines.
  • A collaborative, positive, and proactive team player who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.



How to Apply:


We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Secretária
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados — e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor — e possível — continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Gerenciar agendas múltiplas de executivos, com foco em compromissos institucionais, reuniões internas e externas.
  • Organizar e controlar a logística de viagens nacionais e internacionais (voos, hospedagem, traslados e agendas).
  • Apoiar a organização de eventos, reuniões estratégicas, visitas de consultores e stakeholders externos.
  • Apoiar processos administrativos como solicitações de compras, acompanhamento de contratos, controle de documentos, aprovações e trâmites internos.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento de demandas institucionais e administrativas vinculadas à presidência, diretoria e áreas correlatas.
  • Garantir organização, confidencialidade e priorização adequada das demandas executivas.
  • Antecipar necessidades, propor melhorias de fluxo e atuar de forma proativa no suporte à liderança.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa.
  • Experiência prévia como Secretária Executiva, Assistente Executiva ou função administrativa equivalente.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com rotinas administrativas e institucionais.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de escritório (Pacote Office e/ou Google Workspace).
  • Organização, discrição, autonomia e boa comunicação.

title: Consultor Comercial De Mídia
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO


Atuar na comercialização para o mercado local, apresentando propostas que integrem o ecossistema Iguatemi. Responsável por abrir leads, prospectar negócios e gerar receita com players locais. Conduzir negociações, operacionalizar acordos e atender lojistas, incluindo negócios fechados pelo Key Account. Comercializar espaços para eventos e garantir a execução das oportunidades geradas.



RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?


  • Fidelizar os clientes atuais e prospectar novos, apresentando a Iguatemi, seus shoppings e oportunidades comerciais, a fim de trazer receita e 100% de ocupação para o shopping sob sua gestão;
  • Comercializar propriedades como locações temporárias, mídia, merchandising, eventos, patrocínios e demais que englobam o Planejamento Comercial Anual (PAC) do shopping sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Ter controle rigoroso sobre o fluxo de faturamento dos contratos do shopping, garantindo a menor inadimplência possível;
  • Manter o fluxo direto da informação/comunicação das suas atividades junto à gerência comercial regional, para garantir alinhamento de informações no mercado, evitando a sobreposição de negociações;
  • Visitar a concorrência local/regional, pesquisar oportunidades de negócio nos ambientes digitias (Instagram, LinkedIn, sites de varejo, etc) relevantes a sua unidade a fim de identificar clientes potenciais e se manter atualizado quanto às novidades do mercado;
  • Responsável poratualizar e acompanhar diariamente o placar dos seus índices de performance, resultados, pipeline de vendas, vacância, detectando necessidades de planos de ação para atingimento de metas e maximização do potencial de vendas de propriedades;
  • Realizar reuniões quinzenais junto à gerência geral, Marketing e Operações do seu shopping visando otimizar oportunidades de projetos que possam ser comercializados e alinhar negócios em andamento;
  • Participar de pelo menos uma reunião semanalmente com os demais gestores da unidade de atuação (Matinal) e participar semanalmente da Reunião Comercial Operacional (RECOP);
  • Preparar materiais e apresentações para a diretoria e outras áreas conforme demanda;
  • Gerenciar todo processo de negociação em conjunto com jurídico, shopping e lojista para garantir a efetivação dos contratos nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Garantir o monitoramento de todas as etapas pós negociação, documentação, SISCOM (se houver), assinatura e entrega da propriedade;
  • Dar suporte aosseus clientes em todo o contato com o shopping, desde aprovação de projetos, layouts, autorizações de entrada, assinatura de contrato, quitação de boleto, etc;
  • No caso de shoppings com assistente, fazer a gestão do assistente e sua rotina, com foco em retenção e desenvolvimento de carreira dentro da empresa;
  • Realizar todas as atividades em conformidade com as normas da empresa e ao Programa de Excelência Iguatemi (PEXI).

title: Explorers Manager (After-School Program)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description

The Explorers Manager leads Avenues’ after-school, winter, summer, and academic travel programs, ensuring high-quality learning experiences beyond the classroom that advance the school’s mission. This role combines strategic vision, team leadership, operational excellence, and financial stewardship to deliver programs that inspire students to explore passions, take risks, and grow as global citizens.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of all Explorers programs, including after-school, winter, summer, and academic national and international trips.
  • Develop a clear vision for Explorers programming aligned with Avenues’ educational philosophy and strategic priorities.
  • Recruit, onboard, and manage Explorers staff and more than 30 third-party providers.
  • Partner with academic leadership to design trips aligned with classroom learning.
  • Oversee program logistics, operations, and risk management to ensure smooth and safe execution.
  • Manage the Explorers budget in collaboration with the Finance team.
  • Monitor program quality, enrollment, and satisfaction, using data and feedback to drive improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the school and the Nord Anglia network.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required;
    degree in Education or a related field is a plus.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English.
  • Experience leading or developing educational, enrichment, or experiential programs (extended-day, arts, sports, or experiential learning preferred).
  • Demonstrated ability to build programs and processes in dynamic or ambiguous environments.
  • Strong people management skills, including hiring, onboarding, and managing internal teams and external partners.
  • Experience managing budgets and using data to inform strategic and operational decisions.
  • Proven experience planning and leading national and/or international student trips.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong alignment with Avenues’ mission, values, and commitment to global citizenship.


Additional Information


Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.


Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Fp&A Specialist
description:
JOB PURPOSE:

The FP&A Specialist is responsible for supporting the company´s financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis processes. This role partners closely with business leaders to provide insights that drive strategic decision-making, improve financial performance, and ensure financial discipline across the organization



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Business Partnering

  • Oversee all financial aspects of LATAM finance performance including current and future performance, identification and realisation of opportunities and risks.
  • Support the FP&A Director and the CFO in formulating and executing on strategy across the countries within the region to drive growth and achieve business objectives.
  • Provide technical and analytical expertise and drive improvements in the quality and reliability of financial information.



Strat Planning and Initiatives, Operating Plan and Forecasting

  • Take the lead on key financial processes such as operating plans, financial reviews and provide input into the strategic planning processes.
  • Ensure prompt and effective communication with corporate team
  • To provide input into the strategic planning cycles with respect to sales performance.



Management Reporting, Financial Close and Control Activities

  • Ensure compliance with all ADP financial policies across the BUs ensuring accurate reporting and communication of financial information and messaging.
  • Accountable for revenue, cost, FTE/HC management and all financial KPI´s related regarding budgeting, forecasting including Audit process when required
  • Ensure accurate and timely preparation of reports.
  • Ensure the application of financial policies.



SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE:

Knowledge required:

  • Microsoft Office skills essential, advanced level in Excel and Power Point
  • Protheus, Oracle, Hyperion Enterprise and Hyperion Planning experience preferred.
  • Advanced/Fluent English


Must be able to demonstrate the following competencies;

  • Innovation and problem solving
  • Solution focussed
  • Financial and commercial awareness
  • Communication and influencing
  • Teamwork and co-operation
  • Results orientation
  • Flexibility and organisational commitment
  • Service Orientation



EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:


  • Degree in business related subject preferred
  • Financial Planning experience essential



OTHER:


  • Occasional travel may be required



The work model adopted by ADP is office-based/in-person, with the possibility of working from home up to twice a week.


“Considering that the activities performed by those holding this position involve access to highly confidential and sensitive information of ADP clients and their respective employees, ADP reserves the right to conduct background checks from time to time, as authorized by the Repetitive Appeal Incident No. 01 of the Superior Labor Court, with the consent of the candidate/employee.”

title: Formulation Scientist

Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.


The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.


Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.


Position Scope


The position will be located in Brasil.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.


Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.


Education & Experience:


Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).


Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.




Knowledge, Skills, & Talents


· Spanish and English speaker.

· Knowledge of development Personal Care products (Formulation & process).

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to influence and work in cross functional teams.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Natural collaborator, contributing to a positive team dynamic.

· Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to optimize processes.

title: Data Architect
description:
Do you like to solve complex and high scale data challenges? Do you like to work in a variety of business environments, through high impact projects that use the newest data analytic technologies transitioning to a modern data stack?


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced individual to join our Global Digital Platforms team at Stellantis as a Data Architect. You will be responsible for designing and managing our data infrastructure. You will work closely with various departments to understand their data needs and develop solutions that ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and manage data systems : Ensuring data security and compliance. Create blueprints for data infrastructure and standard.
  • Analyzing Requirements : Analyze structural requirements for new software and applications.
  • Data Migration : Migrate data from legacy systems to new solutions.
  • Modeling Data: Design conceptual and logical data models and flowcharts.
  • Performance Optimization: Improve system performance by conducting tests, troubleshooting, and integrating new elements.
  • Cost-Effective Solutions: Identify and implement cost-effective strategies to fulfill the platform's objectives without compromising on quality and efficiency.
  • Security and Backup: Define security and backup procedures to protect data.
  • Collaboration: Coordinate with the AI & Data business insights teams composed by Data Products, Data Pipeline, AI/GenAI, Data Governances teams to identify future needs and requirements.


Qualifications:

  • Data Warehousing: Understanding of data warehousing solutions and architecture.
  • Data Modeling: Ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
  • ETL Processes: Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes and tools.
  • Experience in Big Data Technologies: Knowledge of big data technologies like SnowFlake, DataBricks, Spark, and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience of cloud based soluions (AWS or Microsoft), system, network and operating system experience
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


This role is a unique opportunity to shape the future of digital platforms at Stellantis and drive innovation in the field of Data Platforms architecture. If you are passionate about technology and eager to lead a team towards success, we encourage you to apply.


"At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future."

title: Gerente De Melhoria Continua E Workforce

Sobre a área:


O Grupo Fleury é uma das mais respeitadas empresas de medicina e saúde do Brasil.


Em melhoria contínua somos responsáveis por trazer projetos com foco em redução de desperdícios, através da metodologia Lean six sigma, com resultados de aumento da eficiência, experiência do cliente ou incremento de receita. O gerente terá como missão liderar, direcionar, gerir e desenvolver os times de Melhoria Contínua e Workforce, desdobrando a estratégia corporativa em projetos e iniciativas estruturadas, alinhadas aos direcionadores estratégicos do Grupo Fleury. É também missão deste cargo fomentar a identificação contínua de oportunidades de melhoria junto às áreas internas e clientes, por meio de rotinas, padrões de gestão e controle de performance. Atuando como catalisador da transformação organizacional, deve garantir a entrega de resultados sustentáveis, visando metas de performance, eficiência operacional, satisfação do cliente e conformidade regulatória.

Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Estatística, Economia, ou áreas afins;

MBA desejável;

Experiência em Gestão de projetos ou processos;

Certificação em metodologia lean six sigma (black belt);

Conhecimento em metodologia de definição e desdobramento de estratégia;

Conhecimento em análises financeiras;

Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas do pacote office;

Inglês avançado.

Visão Sistêmica;

Liderança Colaborativa;

Influência e Comunicação Estratégica;

Orientação para Resultados Sustentáveis;

Pensamento Analítico-Crítico;

Gestão da Complexidade;

Adaptabilidade e Resiliência;

Ética e Integridade;

Mentalidade de Crescimento;

Protagonismo e Autonomia.


O que esperamos?


Visão estratégica e sistêmica;

Capacidade de planejamento e priorização;

Foco no cliente eresultados;

Gestão de mudançae risco;

Negociação e influência;

Alta capacidade de comunicação e empatia;

Gestão de pessoas.


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


- Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

- Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

- Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

- Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado;

- Fortaleçam as relações de confiança da aprendizagem, do respeito e colaboração com as equipes, assumindo o compromisso de influenciar e sustentar o fortalecimento cultural.

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido.

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00h as 17:48h segunda a sexta feira.

Local: Campo Belo, São Paulo - SP.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Finance Business Partner
description:
1. Budgeting & Forecasting:

Develop annual budgets and rolling forecasts, monitor variances, and recommend adjustments to align financial goals with business strategies. Optimize resource allocation and decompose targets to support performance achievement.

2. Business Analysis & Reporting:

Establish a business KPI framework, generate regular analytical reports, identify anomalies, and conduct root cause analysis. Propose actionable strategies to drive operational improvements and cost-efficiency.

Engage with frontline operations to assess projects and design solutions. Provide financial insights for decision-making, resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, and ensure strategic execution.

Identify risks (e.G., revenue inflation, delivery fraud) and implement preventive controls. Monitor cash flow, receivables, and payables to mitigate bad debt and liquidity risks.

5. Data Systems & Tool Development:

Design data models and automation tools (e.G., BI dashboards) to streamline financial processes. Enhance data accuracy and analytical efficiency for precision in business operations.

6. Special Projects & Capability Building:

Lead initiatives like industry research and competitor analysis, standardizing methodologies. Conduct financial training to elevate team expertise and foster sustained business-finance integration.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir trilhas de aprendizagem presenciais, digitais e híbridas, alinhadas à estratégia do negócio e à experiência do colaborador.

  • Administrar plataformas de aprendizagem (LMS/LXP), garantindo usabilidade, engajamento, governança e evolução funcional.
  • Aplicar Inteligência Artificial generativa e preditiva para personalização de trilhas, recomendação de conteúdos e automação de processos educacionais.

  • Implementar novos processos, metodologias e parcerias educacionais, incluindo a homologação e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Atuar na gestão de stakeholders, articulando-se com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e RH para garantir alinhamento e efetividade das soluções educacionais.
  • Oferecer suporte técnico e feedback contínuo aos multiplicadores do conhecimento, estimulando a criação e disseminação de novos conteúdos.
  • Orientar tecnicamente analistas de níveis anteriores, promovendo alinhamentos, padronização de processos e desenvolvimento do time.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de análise de dados (Google Workspace, Power BI, Excel, Looker Studio) para acompanhamento de indicadores e geração de insights.
  • Atuar com metodologias ágeis na condução de projetos educacionais, garantindo organização, priorização e entregas de valor.

Experiência em rotinas financeiras, incluindo análise e conciliação de contas, processamento de pagamentos e interpretação de demonstrativos financeiros. description:
Missão do cargo:

A missão é garantir a integridade da informação que circula nos órgãos de administração, combinando uma gestão eficiente de pendências com uma capacidade analítica crítica e poder de síntese para traduzir temas complexos em linguagem executiva clara. Formação: Graduação em Direito.

  • Capacidade comprovada de escrever de forma concisa e executiva, sintetizando temas jurídicos complexos em parágrafos curtos e diretos;
  • Habilidade paraanalisar criticamente informações e documentos, identificando riscos ou inconsistências ("olho de dono" para erros jurídicos);

  • Pacote Office (Excel e PowerPoint) intermediário, com foco na apresentação da informação.

  • Pós-graduação ou cursos de extensão em Direito Empresarial, Societário, Contratos, Compliance, Governança Corporativa, Relações com Investidores.
  • Vivência prévia em secretarias de governança ou departamentos jurídicos corporativos.

title: Training Analyst
description:
GP Strategies Corporation is one of the world's leading talent transformation providers. By delivering award-winning learning and development solutions, we help organizations transform through their people and achieve meaningful change. GP Strategies has delivered our innovative consulting, learning services, and talent technology solutions to over 6,000 organizations globally.


Title: Training Analyst

Position: Full-time

Work Location: Hybrid ( 3/4 days in Brooklin Novo, Sao Paolo, Brazil )


Job Description

Project Analyst (Portuguese + English) | Hybrid (3/4 days at office in Sao Paolo, Brazil )

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail‑driven Project Administrator to support training operations and manage multiple senior client stakeholders with confidence and professionalism. This is a fully onsite role based in Brazil, requiring fluent Portuguese and functional English.

If you thrive in fast‑paced environments, enjoy coordinating complex learning activities, and excel at stakeholder communication, this opportunity is for you.

About the Role

As a Project Administrator, you will provide comprehensive administrative and system support to learners, facilitators, instructors, and third‑party partners. Your work ensures smooth, accurate, and timely delivery of training programs and learning experiences.

This role is central to the success of our learning operations and requires someone who is structured, resilient, and comfortable interacting with senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Training Coordination & Scheduling

  • Schedule classes and secure all required resources: instructors, facilitators, guest speakers, moderators, and facilities
  • Confirm bookings and ensure alignment with program requirements

LMS (Learning Management System) Administration

  • Load and update classes in the MetLife LMS
  • Manage changes to schedules, facilitators, and class capacities

Learning Materials & Logistics

  • Prepare and distribute physical and digital learning materials
  • Coordinate procurement, printing, and delivery of resources

Learner & Instructor Support

  • Send pre‑course communications and provide ongoing support
  • Serve as the primary point of contact during class delivery
  • Resolve real‑time issues by coordinating with relevant teams

Attendance & Certification Management

  • Generate rosters, track attendance, and update completions
  • Issue completion or failure certificates as required

Operational & Administrative Support

  • Validate invoices related to facilities or materials
  • Support Development Action Plan (DAP) activities
  • Manage user access, upload content, and maintain system data
  • Administer Qualtrics surveys and report satisfaction results
  • Extract Power BI reports and generate insights

Virtual & Onsite Training Support

  • Build session links and moderate Webex/Teams sessions
  • Prepare training rooms, materials, and logistics for in‑person sessions
  • Coordinate coffee breaks, shipping of materials, and IT requests
  • Arrive early to ensure room readiness and conduct technical checks
  • Store materials and close down the room after sessions

Post‑Session Activities

  • Save materials, photos, attendance lists, and survey data
  • Maintain organized digital records

Profile & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2+ years of experience in learning operations, training coordination, or administrative support
  • Strong proficiency in Excel
  • Fluent Portuguese and functional English
  • Experience working with LMS platforms (preferred)

Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to generate data‑driven insights
  • Understanding of employee experience principles
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Highly structured, organized, and detail‑oriented
  • Creative problem‑solver
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic environments


If you’re ready to play a key role in delivering exceptional learning experiences and supporting high‑impact training programs, we’d love to connect with you.

advanced degree is a plus.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist (Indirect Products)
description:
Job Title: Senior Procurement Specialist (Indirect Products) – LAM

Location: Brazil (able to travel around LAM countries)

Employment Type: Full-Time


Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Procurement Specialist to lead indirect products procurement activities especially third party products procurement across LAM. The ideal candidate will possess deep industry expertise, strong supply chain management skills, and fluency in English to drive cross-regional collaboration, ensuring efficient and compliant procurement processes that align with company strategic goals.


Key Responsibilities

1 Supplier Development & Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard indirect products’ suppliers across LAM and globally, ensuring compliance and performance alignment.
  • Conduct regular supplier assessments (quality, cost, delivery) to optimize supply chain resilience.

2 Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation

  • Develop and execute procurement strategies for different product categories, leading negotiations on pricing, contracts, payment terms and delivery terms to achieve cost-saving targets.
  • Manage Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) in compliance with local regulations and corporate policies.

3 Procurement Execution & Documentation

  • Oversee end-to-end procurement processes, including purchase order (PO) drafting and issuance, delivery coordination, goods receipt coordination, installation and acceptance coordination, payment documentation follow-up and procurement related documentation archiving.
  • Ensure seamless order fulfillment: Track deliveries, resolve discrepancies with suppliers/warehouse teams, and maintain accurate records in OA, ERP systems (e.G., SAP).
  • Validate compliance: Verify product specifications during goods acceptance and ensure invoices align with contractual terms before payment approval.

4 Compliance & Risk Mitigation

  • Ensure adherence to local regulations depending on product categories, e.G. Medical Device Regulation, ISO 13485 standards, and internal compliance protocols.

5 Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with HQ PUR, BU, PM, CS, OP, LG, Quality and Legal teams to ensure purchased products meet technical specifications and regulatory requirements.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) projects with supplier sourcing and cost analysis.

6 Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Utilize company own systems and excel to track procurement metrics, generate cost analyses, and report on supplier performance and market trends.


Qualifications

Essential Requirements:

  • 5+ years of procurement experience in the medical device sector, with at least 3 years focused on third-party products/consumables for medical imaging equipments.
  • Procurement experiences for certain indirect product, including but not limited to Administrative & HR, IT & Services, Infrastructure & Engineering, Marketing, MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) Equipment & Tools.
  • Fluent English with proven ability to draft contracts, lead international meetings, and negotiate cross-culturally.
  • Expertise in procurement tools, cost modeling, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with procurement execution workflows (PO management, inventory reconciliation, payment documentation).
  • Strong understanding of local medical device regulations and quality management systems.
  • Responsible, detail-oriented, and highly organized with a commitment to accuracy in documentation and process execution.
  • Integrity and strong teamwork spirit – Ability to build trust with stakeholders and collaborate effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments.
  • Willingness to actively search for resources and travel cross LAM and globally


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Possess a Diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, or Supply Chain, International Business or Business Administration, or a related field
  • Prior experience in multinational corporations or medical device distributors preferred.
  • Multitasking skills and the ability to work under time-constraints and pressure.
  • Strong research and data analysis skill.

Reconhecida na lista da revista Fortune das "Empresas Mais Admiradas do Mundo" de 2024, bem como na lista Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For ® de 2024, a MetLife, por meio de suas subsidiárias e afiliadas, é uma das principais empresas de serviços financeiros do mundo;

  • Apoiar gestão de mudança em alterações de políticas, revisões de faixas, atualizações de programas de incentivo.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations

  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*
